description: This file defines the NewsArticle class, which models a news article with a headline and an HTML body generated with nonsense text. It includes a constructor that generates a random article using a NonsenseGenerator object, and getter methods for the headline and body.

classes.name: NewsArticle
classes.description: Represents a news article with a headline and body, generated dynamically.

methods.name: NewsArticle
methods.description: Constructor that creates a news article with a headline and HTML body using the provided NonsenseGenerator.

methods.name: getHeadline
methods.description: Returns the headline of the news article.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the article body in HTML format.
